# SameDayDesk Payment Integrity

Discovers exact-price machine-commerce actions and the seller-integrity audit that checks constructibility and buyer-required output guarantees.

## What this agent can do (Skills)

### Discover SameDayDesk payment integrity

Returns the canonical SameDayDesk x402 and MPP action catalog, including the one-cent seller-integrity audit and its exact invocation contract.

Examples

- Find the seller-integrity audit and its exact current price.
- List the machine-paid actions SameDayDesk offers.

## About

Learn more at [samedaydesk.com](https://samedaydesk.com).

Machine-facing guide: [agents.samedaydesk.com/skill.md](https://agents.samedaydesk.com/skill.md).
